arithmetic_paths.ARITH_A_REFERENCE: stored element contributions summed in canonical ascending (cell,local_dof) order
arithmetic_paths.ARITH_B_CALIBRATION: same stored contributions split into eight contiguous blocks; each block summed in descending local order; blocks combined ascending
arithmetic_paths.ARITH_C_CONFIRMATION: same stored contributions combined by a fixed balanced binary tree
arithmetic_paths.ARITH_D_P6_BENIGN: same stored contributions combined by a fixed odd-even pair tree; frozen now and not executed in P5
invariants: same stored element residual and tangent contributions
same declared primary and committed states
no physical solve or candidate selection changed by arithmetic projection

calibration_cases.expected: exact zero and exact structural identity

comparison.calibration_envelope: E_m=max(within-process A/B drift, all fresh-process A/A pair drifts, all fresh-process B/B pair drifts)
comparison.mathematical_scope: non-transitive acceptance relation, not an equivalence relation
comparison.structural_fields: exact equality; never absorbed into E_m or T_m

confirmation_case.pass_rule: every numeric metric d_m<=T_m and every structural relation exact

hard_stops: exact null control has any nonzero semantic or numeric drift
a structural identity differs in a benign control
the confirmation control exceeds any frozen T_m
fresh-process repetitions disagree after allowed diagnostic fields are removed
non_retroactivity: Prospective P5 thresholds do not reclassify FEH, MUT, P4d or v2.13 evidence.
